# Test data

The team's test data, read by core/TestData.java: CSV files, a header row first naming the fields; a line
starting with # is a note. Suite Builder wrote this folder once and never touches it again.

- **Reusable** data, any test may read any row, as often as it likes: `TestData.reusable("policies.csv")`.
- **Consumable** data, one row a test, never the same row twice in a run, even with tests in parallel
  (an account a sign-up uses up): `TestData.consumable("example-accounts.csv")`, then `row.get("email")`. A row a failed test took stays
  taken. When none is left the test is skipped, saying so, never failed; the run's report says how many
  rows each file gave.

**Per environment:** `-Denvironment=staging` looks in src/test/resources/data/staging/ first, then here. Keep what differs
between copies of the site (an account that exists only on staging) in the environment's folder, and
what is the same here.

Never real people's data: made-up names, example.com addresses. Passwords are secrets, not data: they
come from the environment (SiteConfig.secret), never a file here.
